title: Malware protection updates need privileged authorization and activity evidence
remediation: Deployment endpoint and hosted security owners identify each malware protection update mechanism and its privileged approving role. Verify a permitted update and denial for an ordinary role or unauthorized configuration change. Capture redacted policy and audit receipts from each assessed protection mechanism and track uncovered assets through G15.

milestones.title: Collect approved update authority and observed privileged update and denied unprivileged change evidence
